canonical.definition: Delta_FP64 = PPL(FC, S, G0) - PPL(FR, S, G0), one deterministic configuration G0 (no interval)

order_null.definition: five FP32 accumulation orders (reference distribution of the same pathway; not pooled with other mechanisms)

execution_marginal.definition: E_{S,G}[PPL(FC,S,G) - PPL(FR,S,G)] over 3 allocation seeds x 5 groupings (existing cross-seed grouping study, ORIGINAL excluded); also the paired mean-NLL version

window_conditional.definition: paired per-window bootstrap for fixed weights (existing results), conditional on G

nonlinearity: E_G[PPL] != exp(E_G[NLL]); the PPL estimand averages paired PPL differences, the NLL estimand averages paired mean-NLL differences; both reported, both nested over (seed, grouping)
